id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

styles.description: A list of styles available to the application.

styleId.description: The id of the current style. Should correspond to a {@link UiSdlThemeTemplate#id} or {@link UiSdlDensityTemplate#id}.

isRoot.description:
Whether this is the root style context. If `true`, this style context will
apply its style variables to the DOM's `html` element. If `false`, this
style context will render its children inside a wrapper `div` element which
has the style variables

enableTunneling.description: Whether to enalbe the tunneling for the ajax call to get {@link UiSdlConfig} config value.

children.description: Components to render inside this style context.

title:
A component that determines what style the application should use and applies
it. This component also handles changes to the style at runtime. Application style can refer
to either the theme (color) or the density (padding, margin).
name: UiSdlStyleContext
